zones.evidence: 用户现场指正汇学堂正东为开放无树草坪；沿用 OSM 草地边界和既有树冠余量。用户指正是留白依据，OSM 仅约束边界。
沿用已验收的图书馆北门中央铺地连接区；铺地存在有校方现场照片依据，完整边界、宽度和高差仍为模型估算。

evidence.location: 博萃路名称及线位来自OSM；取该线从西端起230–350米的一段作为展示试点，远离学生公寓5栋所在东段。不是养护照片拍摄机位定位。
evidence.layout: 校方项目册PDF第33页列有博萃路两旁玉兰树；2024年暑假养护简报具名照片支持沿路成列及留出步行空间。资料未给出逐株坐标。
evidence.dimensions: 12米间距、距道路中心6.2米、10米树高、7米路口退让及12米背景替换半宽为示意参数；最终占地、树冠保留区和三维碰撞检查继续优先。
evidence.species: 校方文字称玉兰/白玉兰；暂用既有阔叶模板0表达行列关系，不声称复原叶形、花期或精确树冠。2024年11月记录提到5栋附近危树清除，本试点不重建该东段树位。

finalGroundExclusion.method: Final derived planar footprints; tree centres including boundaries; courtyard holes retained.
limitations: Centre placement only; canopy/trunk volumes require the final model checks.
Ground-centre pass only; explicit infrastructure/entrance/sculpture crown reservations are applied by the next final pass, separately from actual 3D constraints.
Footprints are planting exclusions, not evidence of solid interiors; mapped courtyard holes remain available.

finalCrownReservations.method: Existing model-space crown reservations, reapplied to all final upstream candidates; conservative radius 4 * height / 9 + 1 m.
limitations: Model planting reservations, not surveyed tree positions, actual canopy silhouettes or a full 3D clearance audit.
Only existing modeled reservations are included; ordinary street shade and unsourced landscape areas are not cleared.
Final underpass buffers follow the displayed sampled path; original upstream source-line exclusions remain additional constraints.

rotationBasis: Position-keyed FNV-1a, decimetres; schematic, not surveyed.

background.evidence: 背景树位为受地图轮廓约束的示意散点。间距、扰动、密度、树高和模板权重沿用原估算参数；不是现场树位或树种调查。

backgroundBasis: Independent SHA-256-seeded candidates in world-anchored cells; local masks and green density cannot shift other cells.

modelBuildingClearance.method: Final grounded trees versus buildings in both LODs: 3D AABB, BVH surface overlap, then bidirectional containment in closed orientable components.
